mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE drops below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where INDPRO declines by > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 5% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises above 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts and retail sales are declining simultaneously, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are declining YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is rising and payroll employment is falling simultaneously, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is rising and PAYEMS is falling MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising and the CPI inflation rate is above 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL is above 130.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is accelerating and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals a stimulative policy environment that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 YoY growth is accelerating and FEDFUNDS is below 2%.
